name: The Ritz-Carlton, Bal Harbour
insider_take: This oceanfront sanctuary sits on one of Miami's most exclusive stretches of sand, where luxury shopping meets pristine beach in the upscale enclave of Bal Harbour.
whats_special: The Ritz-Carlton Bal Harbour boasts the largest spa in Miami Beach and features direct access to the renowned Bal Harbour Shops—home to the highest sales per square foot of any luxury mall in the US. The hotel's signature restaurant, Artisan Beach House, offers oceanfront dining with ingredients sourced from the property's rooftop herb garden.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the 30,000-square-foot spa during weekday mornings for the most serene experience, and ask for ocean-view treatment rooms to maximize your relaxation.
dont_miss: Sunset cocktails at the poolside Ba Bar with panoramic Atlantic views, and early morning walks on the hotel's private stretch of beach—consistently ranked among America's cleanest and safest shores by the Clean Beaches Council.
pros: Prime beachfront location on pristine Bal Harbour beach
Direct access to upscale Bal Harbour Shops luxury shopping center
Sophisticated oceanview rooms and suites with floor-to-ceiling windows
World-class spa and wellness facilities with ocean views
cons: Limited dining variety compared to larger resort properties
